question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
sql:
WITH date_components AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE) as debut_date,
        TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE) as final_game_date,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) as year_diff,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) as month_diff,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) as day_diff,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 1 THEN 31
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 2 THEN 28
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 3 THEN 31
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 4 THEN 30
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 5 THEN 31
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 6 THEN 30
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 7 THEN 31
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 8 THEN 31
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 9 THEN 30
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 10 THEN 31
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 11 THEN 30
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE)) = 12 THEN 31
            ELSE 31
        END as days_in_debut_month
    FROM player
    WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
),
adjusted AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        year_diff,
        month_diff,
        day_diff,
        days_in_debut_month,
        CASE 
            WHEN day_diff < 0 THEN month_diff - 1
            ELSE month_diff
        END as months_raw,
        CASE 
            WHEN day_diff < 0 THEN day_diff + days_in_debut_month
            ELSE day_diff
        END as days_raw
    FROM date_components
),
fully_adjusted AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN months_raw < 0 THEN year_diff - 1
            ELSE year_diff
        END as years,
        CASE 
            WHEN months_raw < 0 THEN months_raw + 12
            ELSE months_raw
        END as months,
        days_raw as days
    FROM adjusted
),
career_span AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        ROUND(ABS(years), 2) + ROUND(ABS(months)::DOUBLE / 12, 2) + ROUND(ABS(days)::DOUBLE / 365, 2) as career_span
    FROM fully_adjusted
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as player_count,
    ROUND(MIN(career_span), 2) as min_span,
    ROUND(MAX(career_span), 2) as max_span,
    ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) as avg_span
FROM career_span
